description: This is a Python source file that defines constants, enums, and a command-line argument parser for generating JSON C++ classes, stub code, and API documentation from JSON and C++ header files. It includes configuration options, global variables, and a Parse function to process command-line arguments.

classes.name: RpcFormat
classes.description: Enumeration for different JSON-RPC data formats: compliant, uncompliant-extended, uncompliant-collapsed.

classes.name: CaseConvention
classes.description: Enumeration for JSON-RPC case conventions: standard, legacy, keep, custom.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Function to parse command-line arguments and set global configuration variables accordingly.
